g.font-family: Noto Sans Devanagari, Inter, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: • Admin opens Admin Panel on tablet/desktop — sees Dashboard.
• Dashboard shows: Today's 12 bookings, 2 pending confirmations, 1 cancellation request.
• Admin goes to 'Manage Bookings' → clicks 'Pending' tab → confirms 2 bookings.
• WhatsApp confirmation messages auto-sent to both customers.
• Admin checks staff availability — one staff called in sick.
• Admin marks that staff as unavailable → their future slots auto-reassigned.
• Admin sends re-booking WhatsApp message to affected customers.
Click 'Add Service', fill Hindi+English name, price, duration, category, upload photo, click
Service appears in user app within 60 seconds (cache refresh)
Open service, edit price field, click Update
New price shown immediately to all users
Service disappears from user-facing service list instantly
Go to Offers, create code with validity dates, discount %, applicable services
Offer banner appears on home page; promo code becomes usable
Go to Branch Settings, change Open/Close time, click Save
Slot generation for that branch immediately reflects new hours
Manual confirmation for walk-in or phone bookings
Status → CONFIRMED, WhatsApp sent to customer
Status → CANCELLED, refund initiated, customer notified
Customer requests via phone or WhatsApp
Admin cancels old, creates new booking on behalf of user
Status → COMPLETED, review request sent to customer
Status → NO_SHOW, loyalty points deducted from customer
Customer walks in without prior booking
Admin creates booking directly from Admin Panel
